_meta.description: Rolling registry of recent post generation characteristics. Used to inject differentiation context into future generation prompts, preventing hook repetition, title cadence cloning, and emotional arc duplication. Capped at 30 recent entries per category.
_meta.usage: Read by scripts/lib/generation-memory.js before generation. Written after each successful post creation. Pass result to generate-post.js as differentiation context.

recentHooks.hook: You turned it down on principle. Somebody waved ChatGPT at you two years ago and you said no, this is my craft, I do this by hand, and you felt clean about it.

Here is a question almost nobody asks before they wire up their next automation: what exactly am I handing off, and does it carry my fingerprints?
Suppression is quiet. That is what makes it so easy to mistake for strength.
What if the thing nagging at you isn't a problem to fix, but a message you keep refusing to open?
A mountain climber a hundred feet up a rock face cannot see the summit. The route curves out of view. Fog sits above. And still, the hand moves to the next hold.
